newsitem.title: USA: Hewlett-Packard cuts prices on Vectra pcs.
newsitem.headline: Hewlett-Packard cuts prices on Vectra pcs.

text.p: Hewlett-Packard Co said Thursday it is making list-price cuts of up to 23 percent on its line of HP Vectra commercial personal computers.
The company said an entry-level HP Vectra VE PC would now start at an estimated street price of $931.

The price cuts also are expected to bring the Pentium processor-based HP Vectra VL PC and the Pentium Pro processor-based HP Vectra VA PC commercial PCs to estimated street prices of six to nine percent below comparable Compaq models, the company said.
The company said the price cuts are effective February 14.
